note: Demo wishlist catalog for the Fit & Confidence Assistant. Reviews are representative ethnic-wear patterns (fit, fabric/threadwork, occasion) — not live-scraped SKUs.

products.name: Peach embroidered Anarkali (Rakhi / daytime function)
reviews: True to size. I am 5'4 and M was perfect for a daytime family function.
Embroidery looks richer in person than on the website photos. Not cheap threadwork.
Wore this for Raksha Bandhan. Dupatta slips a bit but the colour is festive without being heavy.
Runs slightly small in the bust. Ordered L after exchanging M.
Fabric is georgette, lining is decent. Not see-through in daylight.
Size chart matched my usual Myntra M. Length was good, not trailing.
Threadwork on the yoke is neat. A couple of loose threads but nothing that looks fake.
Compared with a similar Kalini set on my wishlist — this one has better flare for photos.
Colour is a bit brighter than the listing. Fine for Rakhi, maybe loud for office.
Quality of the inner lining felt average for the price but embroidery held after one wash.
Ordered my usual M. True to size in waist, a little snug in shoulders.
Friends said it looked expensive. I was worried photos were filtered.
Not for a winter wedding — fabric is light. Perfect for August daytime.
Return exchange was easy when M was tight. L fit well.
Would buy again for festive days. Sizing is mostly honest.

products.name: Wine sequin gown (guest at a wedding)
reviews: Looks glam in pictures but sequins feel sparse near the hem. Photo vs real gap on sparkle.
I am 5'6, usual M. This ran long; I got it hemmed. Fit on bust was true to size.
Wore to a cousin's wedding. Got compliments on colour, not on the fabric feel.
Zipper quality is okay, not premium. For a wedding guest it passed.
Compared this with a kurta set on my wishlist — gown is more formal, kurta more reusable.
Sequins shed a little in the trial. After that it was fine.
Size L was loose in waist. M was better if you can get it hemmed.
Not sure it suits a daytime wedding — better for evening sangeet.
Material is polyester. Looks richer in indoor lighting than sunlight.
True to size if you take your usual. I'm 5'3 and length needed altering.
Quality doubt was why I waited. In hand it is mid, not cheap-cheap.
Would not wear if I needed to sit on the floor a lot — slit and sequins.
Photos from buyers similar to my height helped more than the size chart.
Returned the first colour. This wine one matches occasion better.

products.name: Teal straight kurta set with palazzo
reviews: Kurta is true to size. Palazzo runs large — I tightened the drawstring.
Threadwork on the neck is simple, not the heavy work in the cover photo. Slight photo exaggeration.
Wore to a pooja. Comfortable, reusable, not a one-occasion piece.
Fabric is cotton blend. Breathable. Quality is honest for this price.
I usually wear M. M fit. Length of kurta is regular, not extra long.
Compared with a pink Libas set — this teal hides stains better, embroidery is less dense.
Colour in real is a bit duller than the website.
No lining on palazzo. Fine at home, I wore inner for the function.
Sizing: if you are between M and L, stay M for kurta, palazzo will still be roomy.
Stitching at the side slit came a bit loose after two washes.
Good for daytime. Not festive enough for a wedding unless you add jewellery.
My height 5'2. Kurta was a little long but wearable without alteration.
I almost did not buy because of quality reviews. In hand it was acceptable.
Exchange worked when palazzo waist was huge. They sent a smaller set.

products.name: Ivory silk-blend kurta
reviews: Runs small. Order one size up. I am usual M, L was correct.
Silk blend looks premium in indoor light. In harsh sun it looks more synthetic.
Fit through chest is snug. If you have broad shoulders, size up.
Wore with jeans and also with a churidar. Occasion-flexible.
Quality of buttons is average. Fabric drape is the selling point.
True to brand's other kurtas — they always run a bit small.
Length is good for 5'5. Shorter people may need a small hem.
No heavy threadwork so photo vs real is close. Less quality anxiety.
I compared two ivory kurtas. This one had better reviews on colour staying after wash.
Returned S, kept M even though brand said size up — I am slim.
Office festive Friday yes. Wedding guest maybe too plain.
Smell of new fabric took one wash to go.

products.name: Asymmetric co-ord top (fashion-forward)
reviews: Cute on the model. On me the drape needed a slip. Style risk is real.
Size M matched my usual. Crop length is shorter than photos.
Not sure it suits a family occasion. Better for brunch / friends.
Fabric is stretch. Fit is forgiving. Quality of stitch at the hem is weak.
Compared with a plain top on my wishlist — this one is trendier but less reusable.
Colour is exact. No photo filter issue.
I asked a friend before buying. She said wear it with high-waist only.
Runs true to size. I'm 5'7 and it looks cropped, which is the design.
Would not gift this without knowing their style. Too fashion-forward.
Returned because it did not match the occasion I had in mind (cousin function).

products.name: Nude block heels
reviews: True to size. I am UK 6, took 6. Wide feet may feel tight.
Heel height is wearable for a wedding function. Not stilettos.
Quality of the strap stitching — one reviewer said it loosened. Mine was fine after 4 hours.
Colour matches most ethnic outfits. That is why I saved it next to the anarkali.
Compared prices on another site. Kept this because of return policy.
Size chart was accurate. No half sizes.
Visited a store for a similar pair. These were lighter.
Not for all-day walking. Fine for indoor wedding.
Look cheaper in fluorescent light, fine in evening photos.

products.name: New-season lehenga (few reviews)
reviews: Just received. Blouse runs small, lehenga waist is adjustable.
Can't comment on wash yet. Threadwork looks dense in the one photo I took.
Size chart only. No similar-buyer photos yet.
